Strings.cleaningPanelCaption: Locks the keyboard so you can clean it safely.
Strings.cleaningOverlayMouseHint: Your mouse and touchpad still work
win.cleaningMode.mouseHint: Your mouse and touchpad still work
win.cleaningMode.unlockCaption: Each press must come within 6 seconds of the previous one. Any other key starts over. You can also click Unlock.
win.cleaningMode.limitsTitle: What Windows never lets an app block
win.cleaningMode.limits: Ctrl+Alt+Del and Win+L still work, and so do some laptop keys handled by the firmware (brightness, power). Typing into apps that run as administrator may not be blocked.
win.cleaningMode.couldNotLock: The keyboard could not be locked.
win.cleaningMode.endedNotResponding: Cleaning Mode ended because the app stopped responding.
win.cleaningMode.endedHooksLost: Cleaning Mode ended because Windows stopped sending keyboard events to the app.
